newsitem.title: LEBANON: Death toll from Lebanon shelling climbs to seven.
newsitem.headline: Death toll from Lebanon shelling climbs to seven.

text.p: The death toll from a shelling attack on Lebanon's southern port city of Sidon climbed to seven, hospital sources said on Tuesday.
Riad Firhal, a two-month-old boy hit by shrapnel from one of the 16 shells that landed in Sidon and its suburbs, died overnight, the sources said.
The sources said the boy's mother was also killed by the shelling on Monday.
Forces under the command of pro-Israeli militia leader Antoine Lahd fired the shells at Sidon on Monday. The assault wounded 36 civilians.
